observation.command:
cd /workspace/api 2>&1
echo "=== .env (redacted DB) ==="; grep -iE 'DB_|APP_ENV|APP_URL' .env 2>&1 | sed -E 's/(PASSWORD=).*/\1[REDACTED]/'
echo; echo "=== API ping / health (v1 endpoints) ==="
for p in "api/v1/users" "api/v1/organizations"; do
  echo "--- GET http://localhost:3001/$p (with token) ---"
  TOKEN=$(grep -E 'API_BEARER_TOKEN=' /workspace/web_application/.env.local | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"')
  curl -s --max-time 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.api+json" "http://localhost:3001/$p" -o /tmp/api_resp.json -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"
  head -c 400 /tmp/api_resp.json; echo
done
